cc:Work.dc:title: Box - ABox
cc:Work.dc:description:
A simple Box
This box is kept simple on purpose. If you need more features have a look at the UniversalBox.
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes ABox --x 120 --y 80 --h 60 --outside 0 --bottom_edge h --thickness 3 --burn 0.1 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes ABox --x --y --h --outside --reference --labels
